title: RIFT Vainshtein Screening and Dark Matter Mechanism
description: Test whether a nonlinear kinetic term (Vainshtein mechanism) allows the RIFT scalar to source galactic dark matter halos. Scan Vainshtein coupling alpha_V and mass scale M_V. Also scan a direct matter coupling beta as comparison. Compare rotation curves to NGC 3198.

direct_coupling_scan.comment: Direct matter coupling: beta*Psi*rho_b added to field equation source

notes: SIM99/100 showed Lambda0*R_gal ~ 5e-9 kpc^-2 << m0^2 ~ 1e-8 kpc^-2. The source through the curvature channel is marginal. This sim tests whether Vainshtein nonlinearity and/or direct coupling can overcome this.
